definition: Weights & Biases (wandb) logs training metrics, hyperparameters and artifacts to shared dashboards; Weave traces LLM apps.
details: Founded by Lukas Biewald, Chris Van Pelt and Shawn Lewis in 2017; acquired by CoreWeave in 2025.

explainer.lead: How to install Weights & Biases, a first working example, and where it fits in an AI project.
explainer.createdBy: Weights & Biases, Inc. (Lukas Biewald, Chris Van Pelt, Shawn Lewis).

install.javascript: npm install weave   # W&B Weave for JS/TS

quickstart.python:
import wandb

run = wandb.init(project="tiny-classifier", config={"lr": 1e-3, "epochs": 3})
for epoch in range(run.config.epochs):
    wandb.log({"epoch": epoch, "loss": 1.0 / (epoch + 1)})
run.finish()

explainer.inAi: Watch loss curves live during fine-tuning and keep every experiment reproducible; Weave records prompts and outputs for evaluation.
